CXM FRAMEWORK WIREFRAMES

One dashboard shell, two tenant shapes.

This page holds the full store-based page set. The second page shows the same shell running as a non-store tenant.

Mid-fidelity: real labels, real KPI names, sample values. Structure is the deliverable — colour, iconography and brand come later, per tenant.

LEGEND

Greyscale = the common shell every tenant gets.

Terracotta = either (a) an element conditional on company type, or (b) a note about the framework rather than UI.

Strip every terracotta element from a screen and what remains is the non-store build.

01 · LOGIN

The only place a company is chosen. Sign-in resolves one tenant config bundle: branding, entity model, sources, taxonomy, page set, permissions.

No switcher exists after this point — switching company means signing out.

ROW 2 · COMMON CORE

Overview, Reviews Feed and Insights are identical for every tenant.

Three rules hold on all three: every number carries n and a denominator; every insight links to the reviews that produced it; every page states which sources it excludes and why.

ROW 3 · NETWORK + PRODUCT

Store Performance and City & Region exist only when company_type = STORE_BASED.

Product & Service is common — it is simply the secondary axis here and the primary one for non-store tenants.

ROW 4 · EXPERIENCE

Staff & Service Quality is store-only, and deliberately scoped to store and shift — never to an individual. That constraint is configuration, not a UI preference.

Fulfilment and Support are common to both tenant types.

ROW 5 · MARKET + OPERATE

Competitor enforces a minimum-mention floor: the current Bluestone build charts sentiment for competitors with 14 and 2 mentions, which is exactly what the floor prevents.

Actions is where an insight becomes someone's job, with an SLA and a verification watch.

ROW 6 · PLATFORM

Data Hub is where the honesty lives. Source granularity decides which pages a source is allowed to feed — a source with no location can never appear in store analytics.

Every number elsewhere in the product inherits the limits shown here.

THE SWAP

Compare N1 against 02 on the previous page: same layout, same modules, same query shapes.

Only the entity dimension changes — store / city / region becomes product / channel / plan / segment. Hidden pages 404; they are never shown empty.

PORTFOLIO SET

These four replace the Network group. Each is the structural twin of a store page:

Product & App ↔ Store Performance
Channel Performance ↔ City & Region
Segments & Cohorts ↔ store clusters
Journey Stages ↔ no store equivalent — it is the one genuinely new page.

Segments depends on a CRM join, so it states its denominator prominently: 36% of records carry no customer identity at all.
